# Keyword estimates

Before creating keywords, an estimate says how many matched mentions up to 10 candidate terms would bring a month on each platform, and what tracking each would cost (`cost`: the $5 keyword fee plus $0.008 a match, as `totalLowCents` to `totalHighCents`). Use it when the user asks "how noisy is this term", "what would this cost", or hesitates between candidate keywords. `platforms` narrows it (default every platform) and `matching` takes the rules the keyword would carry (`requiredTerms`, `excludedTerms`, `exactPhrase`).

Each platform's number has a `method`: `index` (counted from the posts Mentio already reads for that term: exact and free) or `sample` (one page of the platform's own search, extrapolated: a range). By default the estimate is FREE (`includePaid` false): paid platforms Mentio does not read yet for the term come back skipped with reason `paid`, youtube with `quota` (bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, podcasts, substack and mastodon are sampled free). With `includePaid: true` they are sampled too, charged per term and platform read (web 2 cents, threads 3, reddit 5, x 5, linkedin 7, tiktok 7, facebook 10, instagram 20; `maxCostCents` is the most), only for a funded workspace (`402 funding_required` / `insufficient_balance`). Ask the user before sending it. At most 30 estimates and 60 platform samples an hour.

`POST /v1/keyword-estimates` answers at once; when `status` is not `done`, poll `GET /v1/keyword-estimates/{id}` every 5 to 10 seconds (usually under a minute). Report per term the monthly range and cost, and say which platforms have no number (`complete: false`). Estimates are kept 30 days.

Base URL `https://api.mentio.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY` on every request, JSON in and out. The `mentio` CLI command for each endpoint is listed for when it is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Examples

```bash
# Two candidate keywords on four platforms, free
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/keyword-estimates" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"terms": ["acme", "acme api"], "platforms": ["reddit", "hackernews", "github", "x"]}'

# Then read it until status is done
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/keyword-estimates/est_..." -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | CLI | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/keyword-estimates` | `mentio keyword-estimates:list` | List keyword estimates |
| `POST` | `/v1/keyword-estimates` | `mentio keyword-estimates:create` | Estimate keyword volume |
| `GET` | `/v1/keyword-estimates/{id}` | `mentio keyword-estimates:get` | Get a keyword estimate |

### GET /v1/keyword-estimates

**List keyword estimates.** The workspace's estimates, newest first, kept for 30 days.

CLI: `mentio keyword-estimates:list`

Query:

- `limit` (integer): Page size, 1 to 100.
- `cursor` (string): nextCursor from the previous page.

Returns: 200, a `LedgerList` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/keyword-estimates

**Estimate keyword volume.** Estimate how many mentions a month up to 10 candidate keywords would bring, and their cost.

- Free by default; `includePaid` also samples paid platforms.
- Poll until `status` is done. See [Keyword estimates](/guides/keyword-estimates).

CLI: `mentio keyword-estimates:create`

Body (JSON):

- `terms` (array of string, required): Up to 10 candidate keywords, each estimated on its own.
- `platforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`. The platforms the keyword would track; omit for every platform (what a new keyword tracks).
- `matching` (object): The rules the keyword would carry, as on a keyword: a sampled post must pass them to count. Omitted fields take the keyword defaults.
  - `requiredTerms` (array of string): The post must ALSO contain these terms, any one of them or all of them per requiredMode. A `*` at the start or the end of an entry is a wildcard (alert* matches alerts and alerting). Empty: no requirement.
  - `requiredMode` (string): one of `any`, `all`. any: at least one required term must appear. all: every one must.
  - `requiredGroups` (array of array of string): Combinations: the post must ALSO contain every term of at least one group (an OR of ANDs), on top of requiredTerms, with the same phrase and wildcard rules. See [Keywords](/guides/keywords#several-searches-in-one-keyword).
  - `excludedTerms` (array of string): A post containing any of these is dropped. A `*` at the start or the end of an entry is a wildcard (beta.* matches beta.0.1; *bot matches nightlybot).
  - `exactPhrase` (boolean): true: only the exact phrase matches (a term sent in double quotes sets it). false: a multi-word keyword also matches its words close together, kept and billed only when scored relevant. See [Keywords](/guides/keywords#the-exact-phrase-only).
- `includePaid` (boolean): Also sample the paid platforms. See [Keyword estimates](/guides/keyword-estimates#cost).

- false (default): index numbers and free samples only; costs nothing.
- true: also the paid platforms, 2 to 20 cents per term and platform read; funded only.

Returns: 201, a `KeywordEstimate` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/keyword-estimates/{id}

**Get a keyword estimate.** Each term's expected matched mentions a month per platform, the monthly cost range, and what the estimate itself cost.

CLI: `mentio keyword-estimates:get`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Estimate id (est_...).

Returns: 200, a `KeywordEstimate` (see Shapes below).

## Shapes

### KeywordEstimate

- `id` (string, required): Estimate id (est_...).
- `status` (string, required): one of `queued`, `running`, `done`, `failed`. queued: accepted, nothing sampled yet. running: platforms being sampled. done: every platform reported. failed: no platform of any term has a number.
- `includePaid` (boolean, required): Whether paid platforms were sampled.
- `platforms` (array of string, required): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. The platforms asked for.
- `terms` (array of object, required): One entry per term, in the order sent.
  - `term` (string, required): The candidate keyword, normalized as a keyword stores it.
  - `monthly` (object, required): Sum over the platforms that have a number.
    - `low` (integer, required): Low end of the expected matched mentions a month.
    - `high` (integer, required): High end of the expected matched mentions a month.
  - `complete` (boolean, required): true when every platform asked for has a number; false when some were skipped or failed (their volume is not in the sum).
  - `cost` (object, required): What tracking this term would cost a month at today's prices, with no mention cap.
    - `keywordCents` (integer, required): The keyword fee for a month ($5).
    - `mentionsLowCents` (integer, required): Matched mentions a month at $0.008, low end.
    - `mentionsHighCents` (integer, required): Matched mentions a month at $0.008, high end.
    - `totalLowCents` (integer, required): Keyword fee plus mentions, low end.
    - `totalHighCents` (integer, required): Keyword fee plus mentions, high end.
  - `platforms` (array of object, required): One entry per platform asked for.
    - `platform` (string, required): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Platform, one of:
- Social: bluesky, x, reddit, linkedin, facebook, instagram, tiktok, threads, mastodon
- Developer: hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto
- Media: news, youtube, podcasts (with transcripts), rss (keyword feeds)
- Web: web (blogs), substack, producthunt
- Reviews: appstore, googleplay, trustpilot, googlemaps (Google reviews)
    - `status` (string, required): one of `queued`, `running`, `done`, `skipped`, `failed`. queued: not sampled yet. running: being sampled. done: it has a number. skipped: no number (see reason). failed: the sample failed (see reason).
    - `reason` (string, required, nullable): one of `unsupported`, `paid`, `quota`, `credentials`, `budget`, `rate_limited`, `error`, `timeout`. Why a platform has no number; null otherwise.

- unsupported: no term search, and no index for the term.
- paid: a paid platform, includePaid was false.
- quota: youtube, its quota is kept for live tracking.
- credentials, budget: not connected, or its monthly budget is spent.
- rate_limited, error, timeout: the sample failed.
    - `method` (string, required, nullable): one of `index`, `sample`. index: counted from the posts Mentio already reads for this term (the closest to what a keyword gets). sample: one page of the platform's own search, extrapolated to a month. null without a number.
    - `monthly` (object, required, nullable): Expected matched mentions a month on this platform; null without a number.
      - `low` (integer, required): Low end of the expected matched mentions a month.
      - `high` (integer, required): High end of the expected matched mentions a month.
    - `sample` (object, required, nullable): What the number rests on; null without a number.
      - `read` (integer, required): Posts read (index: posts counted).
      - `matched` (integer, required): Of them, holding the term and passing the rules.
      - `days` (number, required): The span of time they cover, in days.
    - `costCents` (integer, required): What sampling this platform cost: 0 for index numbers and free platforms.
- `costCents` (integer, required): What the estimate has cost so far (paid samples read); charged to the wallet when it completes.
- `maxCostCents` (integer, required): The most it can cost: every paid sample it may read. The wallet had to cover it when it started.
- `createdAt` (string, required): When the estimate was started.
- `completedAt` (string, required, nullable): When it reached done or failed; null while it runs.

### LedgerList

- `data` (array of object, required): Ledger entries, newest first.
  - `id` (string, required): Ledger entry id (led_...).
  - `kind` (string, required): one of `signup_credit`, `topup`, `refund`, `debit_keyword_days`, `debit_mentions`, `debit_comments`, `debit_searches`, `debit_estimates`, `adjustment`, `transfer_in`, `transfer_out`. signup_credit, topup, refund, debit_keyword_days, debit_mentions, debit_comments, debit_searches (on-demand search results), debit_estimates (paid samples of keyword estimates), adjustment, transfer_in (money moved in from the parent or a child workspace) or transfer_out (money moved out to one).
  - `amountCents` (integer, required): Integer USD cents; credits positive, debits negative.
  - `day` (string, required, nullable): Debit rows: the last UTC day the row settled (YYYY-MM-DD).
  - `units` (integer, required, nullable): Debit rows: cumulative units (mentions or keyword-days) settled up to this row; on debit_estimates, the paid samples of that one estimate.
  - `note` (string, required, nullable): Free text on credits and adjustments.
  - `polarOrderId` (string, required, nullable): Top-ups and refunds: the Polar order.
  - `transfer` (object, required, nullable): transfer_in and transfer_out rows: the transfer and the other workspace; null on every other row.
    - `id` (string, required): Transfer id (trf_...); the other workspace's row carries the same id.
    - `workspaceId` (string, required): The other workspace of the transfer (org_...): the child it funded, or the parent it came from.
  - `createdAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.
- `nextCursor` (string, required, nullable): Pass it back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.
